item.title: IDF chief warns ‘no safe place’ for Iranian regime as fighting enters second week
item.description: Israel targets IRGC air force HQ, space center, after oil strikes said to frustrate DC; IDF says Israel will 'pursue every successor' to Khamenei; US accuses Tehran of attacking from civilian areas as Iran says no desire for truce The post IDF chief warns ‘no safe place’ for Iranian regime as fighting enters second week appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Arraba mayor and his deputy shot and injured amid unrelenting crime wave
item.description: Masked assailant ambushes Ahmad Nassar and Anwar Yassin while sitting at bakery in northern Arab city; separately, man succumbs to wounds from shooting last week in Jaffa The post Arraba mayor and his deputy shot and injured amid unrelenting crime wave appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: NYPD confirms explosive thrown against anti-Muslim protest near Mamdani residence
item.description: Police commissioner says homemade bomb could have caused 'serious injury or death'; officers evacuate buildings in area due to another suspicious device The post NYPD confirms explosive thrown against anti-Muslim protest near Mamdani residence appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Citing conflict of interest concerns, Justice Ministry won’t hand Sde Teiman leak probe to AG
item.description: Ministry's legal aide tells court that Gali Baharav-Miara's subordinate, State Attorney Amit Aisman, is the 'most senior official' who can oversee case; petitioning group blasts move The post Citing conflict of interest concerns, Justice Ministry won’t hand Sde Teiman leak probe to AG appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Trump to Times of Israel: It’ll be a ‘mutual’ decision with Netanyahu regarding when Iran war ends
item.description: US president, in phone interview, clarifies that he'll make final call to end operation 'at right time'; says he and PM ‘worked together' against Islamic Republic: 'We’ve destroyed a country that would have destroyed Israel' The post Trump to Times of Israel: It’ll be a ‘mutual’ decision with Netanyahu regarding when Iran war ends appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Iran names Khamenei’s shadowy, hardline son Mojtaba as new supreme leader
item.description: IRGC ally's appointment comes after Trump dismissed him as an unacceptable 'lightweight,' and Israel threatened to kill anyone picked by regime to succeed slain leader The post Iran names Khamenei’s shadowy, hardline son Mojtaba as new supreme leader appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: More hardline than his father, Mojtaba Khamenei’s appointment signals defiance and revenge
item.description: Successor and son of Iran's slain supreme leader will 'have no choice' but to expand repression, even if war ends, official says, warning world 'will miss the era of his father' The post More hardline than his father, Mojtaba Khamenei’s appointment signals defiance and revenge appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: ‘Country’ Joe McDonald, ’60s US rock star, proud protest counterculture icon, dies at 84
item.description: Named after Stalin by his once-Communist Jewish mother and Presbytarian father, anti-war activist starred at Woodstock after rising to fame with 'I-Feel-Like-I’m-Fixin’-To-Die Rag' The post ‘Country’ Joe McDonald, ’60s US rock star, proud protest counterculture icon, dies at 84 appeared first on The Times of Israel.
